body: Design one square sticker sheet containing exactly sixteen separate stickers in a clean 4-by-4 grid. Use the uploaded character as the sole character, keeping the face, hairstyle, outfit and colors consistent. Give each cell a different everyday emotion or gesture: joy, surprise, thanks, encouragement, sleepiness, celebration, curiosity, agreement, apology, determination, greeting, laughter, relief, confusion, excitement and affection. Simple expressive cartoon drawing, white cutout borders, generous separation. Add one short Chinese caption per cell from this supplied list: {{captions}}. Avoid background scenes and overlapping stickers. Render every caption verbatim, in reading order, without shortening or omitting any Chinese character.
